type-system.twistDescription: Twist A — Font size scale ×1.15 (intensity 3). All heading font-size cssVars scaled up 15%. Proprietary Segoe UI fonts replaced: headings use Fraunces (editorial serif) via Google Fonts CDN; body/UI use Inter via Google Fonts CDN.

motion-system.twistDescription: Twist C — Easing curve swap (intensity 3): all 'linear' and 'ease' timing functions replaced with 'ease-in-out'. Every transition now uses a smooth, symmetrical deceleration curve.

grid-system.twistDescription: Twist B — Gap value scaling ×1.4 (intensity 3). All explicit columnGap and rowGap values multiplied by 1.4: reasons-grid 32.038px→44.853px col, 53.95px→75.53px row; services 31.042px→43.459px; sector splits 16.6px→23.24px.

spacing-system.twistDescription: Twist B — Section-specific breathing room +32px (intensity 3): section paddingTop and paddingBottom increased from 144px to 176px.

interaction-states.twistDescription: Twist A — Snappier hover transitions (intensity 3): all hover/active transition durations reduced by 0.1s (0.3s → 0.2s) for crisper state changes.

nav-system.twistDescription: Twist A — Nav height +16px (intensity 3): geometry.height increased from 28.789px to 44.789px for more vertical presence.

concept-summary.twistDescription: Twist A — Kinetic shift applied to Hero Section paragraph: rewritten to foreground temporal sequence of animations, framing the reveal as choreographed motion event. All other paragraphs unchanged.
